summary:
This is the no-login design. An anonymous visitor can use everything the site shows. Learner data lives in one typed, versioned browser store (src/lib/learner-store), with one repository per feature. Account features stay behind one build-time switch, ACCOUNTS_ENABLED, which is the existing accountUI flag, plus a server gate that requires the switch, DATABASE_URL, a real sign-in provider and a session.

What I checked in the code:
- Every one of the 23 available labs redirects to the placeholder sign-in page.
- The "Teach it back" widget on every lesson and the floating AI assistant on every learning page both call auth-guarded AI routes, so for anonymous visitors their controls fail silently or show "Sign in to use the AI tutor."
- SessionProvider calls /api/auth/session on every page mount and every tab focus. That is a dynamic Worker request each time.
- Lessons already read content with fs at build time and are served prerendered. Labs can use the same pattern.

Labs:
- Lab pages become static pages built at build time, with all declared file contents passed in as props.
- Steps, editing, autosave, self-attestation, browser-side structural grading (the graders import nothing) and revealing solutions after completion all run against the local store.
- Simulation stays server-only. On this deploy it is replaced by "Run it on your simulator" with a zip download.

Flashcards and review:
- Cards gain Again/Hard/Good/Easy ratings using one shared SM-2 scheduler.
- A local review queue lives at /dashboard/review. The 624 KB deck registry is resolved on the server and no longer ships to lesson pages.

Other learner pages:
- Dashboard: rebuilt from real local data.
- Notebook: fed by Teach-it-back.
- Settings: theme plus export, import and reset of local data.
- Placement quiz: saves its result locally.

Pages that need several users' data, a secret or real content stay hidden:
- Community, the notifications page, the AI tutor and simulation (they need several users' data or a secret).
- Assessment center (mostly mock content).
- Projects and history (placeholder content).
- Coverage (an editorial tracker): its route is deleted.

The work is split into a shared foundation and seven packages with no file in common. They can run in parallel once the foundation lands.
architecture:
1. THE ONE SWITCH (where server persistence is decided)
- src/lib/persistence/accounts.ts (client-safe, no server imports) exports `ACCOUNTS_ENABLED = featureFlags.accountUI`. It is inlined at build time from NEXT_PUBLIC_FEATURE_FLAG_ACCOUNT_UI, or turned on by FEATURE_FLAGS_FORCE_ON.
- src/server/persistence-gate.ts (server only; uses no `server-only` package because none is installed):
  - `isServerPersistenceConfigured(env = process.env)` is true only when ACCOUNTS_ENABLED, env.DATABASE_URL, a real provider (GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, or NODE_ENV!=='production' && AUTH_TEST_MODE==='true') and NEXTAUTH_SECRET or SESSION_SECRET are all present.
  - `resolveServerPersistence()` returns `{mode:'local'}` without importing '@/lib/auth' when not configured. Otherwise it dynamically imports auth, calls getServerSession, and returns `{mode:'server', userId}` or `{mode:'local'}`.
- src/lib/persistence/target.ts ('use client') exports `usePersistenceTarget(): {target:'local'|'server'; ready:boolean}`.
  - The branch is chosen on the build-time constant: `ACCOUNTS_ENABLED ? useSessionTarget : () => ({target:'local', ready:true})`.
  - With accounts off it never calls useSession.
  - With accounts on: authenticated means 'server', unauthenticated means 'local', loading means ready:false.
- src/lib/site-features.ts exports frozen `SITE_FEATURES`:
  - dashboard, review, notebook, settings: true
  - accounts: ACCOUNTS_ENABLED
  - community: featureFlags.community
  - aiTutor: featureFlags.aiTutor && ACCOUNTS_ENABLED
  - simulation: featureFlags.simulation && ACCOUNTS_ENABLED
  - Two new flags, aiTutor and simulation, default off. Their environment variables are NEXT_PUBLIC_FEATURE_FLAG_AI_TUTOR and NEXT_PUBLIC_FEATURE_FLAG_SIMULATION.
  - tracking and personalization lose their learner-page gating. They stay defined for future server sync and for previewing draft pages.
- Behaviour with accounts off:
  - ClientProviders does not mount SessionProvider, which removes the /api/auth/session fetch on every page and every focus.
  - useAuth() returns the constant {user:null, loading:false, signOut: no-op}. It stays the only entry point to identity; components never call useSession directly.
  - /api/auth/[...nextauth] answers 404 {error:'ACCOUNTS_DISABLED'} for every method. NextAuth and authOptions are imported lazily inside the handler, so the placeholder sign-in page disappears.
  - No page calls requireSession or Prisma.
  - The /api/me/*, /api/labs/run, /api/simulate, /api/ai/* and /api/reviews routes stay as they are and keep failing closed with 401. They are the backends for when accounts return.

2. THE CLIENT STORE: src/lib/learner-store/ (one module, barrel index.ts, no zod in client code, hand-written validators)
- storage.ts, `safeStorage`:
  - Methods: get, set, remove, keys(prefix).
  - On first use it probes localStorage. SecurityError or TypeError gives status 'unavailable' with an in-memory Map fallback.
  - QuotaExceededError (names QuotaExceededError and NS_ERROR_DOM_QUOTA_REACHED, codes 22 and 1014) gives status 'full'. The value is kept in a memory overlay for the session.
  - Exposes `getStorageStatus()`, `subscribeStorageStatus()` and `estimateBytes(prefixes)`.
- record.ts:
  - `defineRecord<T>({key, version, empty, parse(data): T|null, migrations?: {[fromV]: (data)=>unknown}, legacyRaw?: boolean})` returns `{key, version, empty, read(): T, write(v): 'saved'|'memory-only'|'blocked-newer-version', update(fn), clear(), subscribe(cb)}`.
  - `defineKeyedRecord<T>({prefix, version, parse})` returns `{get(id), set(id,v), remove(id), list(): {id,value}[], subscribe(cb)}`.
  - Envelope `{"v":<int>,"data":<T>}`. Legacy keys use legacyRaw and are stored bare.
  - Unparseable JSON or a failed parse reads as `empty`. It is logged once and the stored value is not overwritten until the next explicit write.
  - v < version runs the migrations in order and writes back. v > version reads as empty, writes are refused, and the newer data is never overwritten.
  - Snapshots are cached per raw string, so useSyncExternalStore gets the same object when nothing changed.
  - A change event in the same tab, plus window 'storage' events from other tabs (key null means every record), notify subscribers.
- react.ts: `useRecord(record)`, `useKeyedRecord(record,id)`, `useKeyedRecordList(record)` and `useStorageStatus()`, all built on useSyncExternalStore.
  - getServerSnapshot returns empty, null, [] or 'available', so the server render and first hydration always show the empty state and storage is never read during render.
- time.ts: `localDayKey(ms)` gives 'YYYY-MM-DD' in the learner's local zone, plus `endOfLocalDay(ms)` and `addDays`.
- keys.ts, KEY_PREFIX = 'sv-uvm-guide:'. New keys are all versioned (envelope v=1):
  - `sv-uvm-guide:meta` {schemaVersion:1, createdAt}
  - `sv-uvm-guide:lab:<labId>@<labVersion>` (keyed)
  - `sv-uvm-guide:flashcards`
  - `sv-uvm-guide:notebook`
  - `sv-uvm-guide:assessments`
  - `sv-uvm-guide:lessons`
  - `sv-uvm-guide:activity`
  - Legacy keys stay owned by their existing code and are included in export, import and reset: `curriculumProgress`, `svuvm.learningRoute` (ROUTE_STORAGE_KEY), `sv-uvm-guide:exercise:<id>` and `sv-uvm-guide:exercise-analytics:<id>`.
  - Excluded from backup: `sv-uvm:outline-collapsed` (UI convenience) and next-themes' `theme`.
- repositories/ (data contracts only; feature behaviour lives in the feature packages):
  - labs.ts `labProgressRecords`: LabProgressRecord {labId, labVersion, currentStepId, completedSteps[], stepEvidence{[stepId]: {kind:'graded', graderId, graderVersion, stepVersion, recordedAt, origin:'browser'|'server'} | {kind:'self_attested', stepVersion, recordedAt}}, fileBuffers{path:content}, status:'in_progress'|'completed', startedAt, updatedAt, completedAt?}. Helpers: `labRecordId(id,version)` and `listLabRecords(labId?)`.
  - flashcards.ts `flashcardRecord`: {cards{[cardId]: SrsCardState{deckId, interval, repetitions, ease, dueAt, lastReviewedAt, lapses, reviews}}, decks{[deckId]: {lessonHref, lessonTitle, cardIds[], firstSeenAt}}, positions{[deckId]: index}}. Helpers: `isCardDue(state, now)` (dueAt <= endOfLocalDay(now)) and `countDueCards(data, now)`.
  - notebook.ts `notebookRecord`: {entries: NotebookEntry{id, kind:'teach-back'|'note', lessonPath?, lessonTitle?, title, body (≤8000 chars), createdAt, updatedAt}[]}, capped at 500 entries. Helpers: `upsertTeachBack` and `removeEntry`.
  - assessments.ts `assessmentRecord`: {placement: PlacementAttempt{assessmentVersion, scoringVersion, responses[{questionId, optionId}], tier, routeId, percent, categories[{id, percent}], completedAt}[] (newest first, max 10), quizzes{[lessonPath]: {best, last, total, attempts, lastAt}}}.
  - lessons.ts: `lessonLogRecord` {lessons{[lessonPath]: {firstVisitedAt, lastVisitedAt, visits}}}, plus `curriculumProgressRecord` (legacyRaw key 'curriculumProgress', type CurriculumProgressData = the current ProgressData shape).
  - activity.ts `activityRecord`: {days{[dayKey]: Partial<Record<'lesson'|'lab-step'|'lab-complete'|'review'|'quiz'|'placement'|'note', number>>}}, keeping the last 400 days. Helper: `recordActivity(kind, now?)`.
  - legacy.ts: read-only `readExerciseProgress()` and `readSelectedRouteRaw()` for the dashboard and backup.
- backup.ts:
  - `exportLearnerData()` returns LearnerDataBundle {format:'sv-uvm-guide/learner-data', schemaVersion:1, exportedAt, entries{[key]: parsed JSON}}.
  - `importLearnerData(bundle, 'replace'|'merge')` validates each entry with its record's parse, ignores unknown keys and reports counts.
  - `resetLearnerData()` removes only the known keys.
  - The bundle is also the payload for the future account import.
- Budget: labs at most about 1 MB in total, flashcards about 200 KB, notebook at most about 4 MB worst case and normally far less, everything else a few KB. localStorage is enough and IndexedDB is not needed. StorageStatusNote warns at more than 3.5 MB.
- Shared UI, src/components/learner/:
  - StorageStatusNote: aria-live. "Saved in this browser", or "This browser isn't saving your progress (storage blocked or full). Download a backup to keep it."
  - LearnerDataControls: Export JSON, Import with a preview and then Replace or Merge, Reset with a two-step inline confirm.
  - LearnerSectionNav: nav "Your learning" linking Dashboard, Review, Notebook, Settings, with aria-current.
  - src/lib/download.ts: downloadBlob and downloadText.

3. FEATURE SEAMS: each feature defines an interface with a local implementation now and a server implementation selected by usePersistenceTarget().target==='server'
- Labs: LabProgressStore {load, saveWorkspace, completeSelfAttestedStep, checkGradedStep, reset}.
  - createBrowserLabProgressStore uses labProgressRecords, the pure policy and the in-browser graders.
  - createAccountLabProgressStore wraps the existing GET, PATCH and POST /api/me/labs/:id/progress and POST /api/labs/run, so server-graded evidence is used when accounts are on.
- Flashcards: FlashcardReviewStore {rate(cardId, quality), enrollDeck, dueQueue, ...}. Local now. The server version later reuses src/app/actions/srs.ts behind requireSession, which by then shares the same pure scheduler.
- Placement: always saved locally; it also POSTs /api/me/assessments when the target is 'server'.
- Notebook, lesson log, activity and quiz results: local only for now. A server version can be added later behind the same records.
- Later migration: a new POST /api/me/import receives the export bundle on first sign-in. It re-validates every entry and re-grades graded lab steps marked origin:'browser' with the versioned graders. It merges SRS by newest lastReviewedAt per card and notebook entries by id with newest updatedAt.

4. LABS PIPELINE
- page.tsx:
  - generateStaticParams lists the available lab ids.
  - `dynamicParams = false`, so unknown and coming_soon ids 404.
  - force-dynamic is removed. Optionally add `dynamic = 'error'` to keep the page static.
  - No auth or Prisma imports.
- readLabFilesForBuild(lab) in src/lib/lab-assets.ts reads the declared guide, starter and reference files plus solutions at build time with the existing traversal checks. The 256 KB per-file and 1 MB per-lab caps fail the build.
- The props carry files[] and solutions[] (at most about 55 KB per lab today). This is the same fs-at-build pattern lesson-loader uses, and OpenNext already serves lessons from static assets this way.
- The client restores progress in an effect behind a `loaded` flag. Autosave (600 ms debounce) and the action buttons are disabled until loading finishes.
- A shared pure policy, src/lib/lab-progress-policy.ts, is used by src/server/labs.ts, /api/labs/run and the browser store, so browser and server can never disagree.

5. NAVIGATION AND STATIC PAGES
- Navbar, the course outline and the Alt+3 shortcut always link the Dashboard.
- The Review, Notebook and Settings pages are reached through LearnerSectionNav and the flashcard "N due" chip.
- /dashboard, /dashboard/review, /dashboard/notebook and /settings are static server shells with client islands. robots.txt already disallows /dashboard and /settings.
- Available labs are added to the sitemap.
- With their switches off these pages call notFound(): /notifications (accountUI); /assessment (tracking); /projects and /history (personalization, placeholder content); /community (community, unchanged).

6. TURNING GUARDS BACK ON LATER
1. Set the NEXT_PUBLIC_FEATURE_FLAG_ACCOUNT_UI build flag, DATABASE_URL, the Google keys and NEXTAUTH_SECRET.
2. Results:
   - SessionProvider mounts, the account menu and notifications appear, and /api/auth works.
   - usePersistenceTarget switches signed-in learners to the server stores, while signed-out learners keep the local store.
3. To bring back the AI tutor, set the aiTutor flag and GEMINI_API_KEY.
4. To bring back simulation, set the simulation flag and the queue env.
5. Add /api/me/import for the first-sign-in merge.

7. TEST INFRASTRUCTURE
- playwright.config.ts and scripts/run-e2e-tests.cjs default to anonymous mode: default flags, AUTH_TEST_MODE=false, no DATABASE_URL, a dummy SESSION_SECRET.
- E2E_ACCOUNTS=true restores today's mode (all flags forced on plus test auth and a disposable DB).
- tests/fixtures/auth.ts exports `ACCOUNTS_E2E` and `requireAccountsMode(test)`, which skips account-only specs.

featureDecisions.feature: Lab page /practice/lab/[labId] and its access gate
featureDecisions.details: requireSession, labAccessService and getLabProgress are removed. The page is prerendered with generateStaticParams for the 23 available labs and dynamicParams=false; unknown and coming_soon ids still 404, and there is no redirect to sign-in. It is served from Worker static assets like lessons.

Contents are read at build time with the existing declared-path and traversal checks. The 256 KB per-file and 1 MB per-lab caps fail the build. Contents reach the client as props, and the client no longer fetches /api/me/labs/.../assets. That route stays for the account era and fails closed.

Stored under localStorage key sv-uvm-guide:lab:<labId>@<version> (envelope v1) through LabProgressStore, with a 600 ms debounce after load. On restore, unknown paths, unknown steps and oversized buffers are dropped. When storage is blocked or full, a warning and 'Download files' appear. A record saved under an older lab version is detected and offered as a download.

featureDecisions.feature: Self-attested lab steps and step ordering
featureDecisions.details: A pure applyStepCompletion in src/lib/lab-progress-policy.ts checks that the step exists, that its completion kind matches and that the previous step is done. It orders steps canonically and completes the lab when every step is done. The browser store and src/server/labs.ts both use it, and the existing UI copy stays.

graderRegistry has no imports and runs in the browser, after the same prechecks as /api/labs/run (shared checkGradedSubmission). Evidence is recorded as graded with origin:'browser'. A grader that sets requiresSandbox shows 'This check needs the simulator service'. The result is labelled 'Structural check in your browser: it does not compile or simulate.'

Solution contents ship in the page props. They are listed under 'Lab files' only once the local record's status is completed; an optional 'Show solution early' sits behind an inline confirm. This is documented as a learning nudge, not access control, and the owner should sign off.

featureDecisions.feature: Lab simulation panel and job queue
featureDecisions.details: CodeExecutionEnvironment renders only when SITE_FEATURES.simulation is on (simulation flag plus accounts). Otherwise a 'Run it on your simulator' panel offers 'Download workspace (.zip)' (current editable buffers, read-only files, and solutions once revealed) and points to the lab guide's run command. /api/simulate stays guarded.

labRequiresSignIn() is replaced by labProgressNote(): 'Your progress is saved in this browser.' The link keeps aria-describedby and the pinned 'Launch Lab' name. A client-only LabProgressBadge shows 'In progress · step X of N' or 'Completed'.

featureDecisions.feature: Practice Hub, lesson practice block, module cards, learning paths and the home card
featureDecisions.details: Every 'Sign in to open' line is removed or rewritten: 'Labs open after you sign in', '(sign-in required)', 'Sign in to run labs.', the home card's 'Sign in to open a lab.' and the learning-path note 'sign-in required'. 'Auto-graded steps' becomes 'Auto-checked steps (structural, in your browser)'. Hub cards get the progress badge.
These are pure and need no session. They work as soon as the page renders statically.
No generator change is needed, because contents are read by the page at build time. labRequiresSignIn is retired.

LessonPractice resolves the deck on the server and passes plain cards, so the first card is server-rendered and the 'No flashcards available' placeholder goes. After a flip, an Again/Hard/Good/Easy group appears (quality 0/3/4/5) and saves through FlashcardReviewStore. The last-viewed position is saved per deck. An 'N due for review' chip links /dashboard/review. Pinned selectors stay: role=button with aria-pressed, 'Next card', 'Card N of M'.

The 624 KB registry chunk leaves lesson pages: the server resolves decks and the review page loads them per deck with dynamic import. The 30 cards without ids (A-UVM-1, A-UVM-2, A-UVM-3) get explicit ids, and validate-flashcards.cjs plus the registry test now require explicit ids.

A pure src/lib/srs/scheduler.ts scheduleReview(state, quality, now) is shared by the local store and the server action reviewFlashcard, which stays behind requireSession. 'Hard' now passes (quality 3) instead of resetting the card. Due-ness uses the learner's local day.

It is rebuilt as /dashboard/review on the local store, and the 404'd memory-hub route and client are deleted. The queue shows due cards oldest first, plus a lane of new cards from decks seen in lessons (10 a day). The learner rates exactly the card shown, and the list clamps after each rating. Each card links back to its lesson. The empty state explains how to build the queue.
Removed together with its test. In local mode, a deck is 'created' by enrolling it from a lesson. Cards written by learners could come back later with accounts.
Orphaned developer tool, not flashcard review. It still fails closed with 401 and is not added to any learner page.

featureDecisions.feature: Legacy TopicPage template with Firestore progress
featureDecisions.details: Dead code, deleted together with tests/components/TopicPage.test.tsx. Lesson position and completion live in the local store instead.

The tracking notFound gate and every made-up number go (the 'verification lead' greeting, 65%, badges, community rank, 'Generate new plan'). It shows real local data: continue on the chosen route, lessons opened or done per tier and module, labs in progress or done, cards due, notebook count, the last placement result, lesson quizzes under 75%, exercise best scores, streak and the last 7 days. It has an honest empty state, the note 'Stored only in this browser', and a link to Settings for backup.

This is an editorial migration tracker with stale statuses, not a learner feature. The route, CoveragePageClient and src/lib/curriculum-status.ts are deleted. Learner-facing 'coverage' becomes the per-tier and per-module progress on the dashboard.

featureDecisions.feature: Lesson visit tracking, 'Pick up where you left off', route position and Visited badges
featureDecisions.details: Already free of login. useCurriculumProgress moves onto curriculumProgressRecord, an external store, so instances stay in sync and no stale snapshot overwrites another. LessonVisitTracker also records a per-lesson visit log and 'lesson' activity. A new 'Mark this lesson as done' toggle uses completeLesson and uncompleteLesson.
When a quiz finishes, best, last, total and attempts are recorded for the lesson path from usePathname, along with 'quiz' activity. The quiz UI does not change.

The attempt is saved locally (assessments record) and 'placement' activity is logged. On a revisit the page shows 'Your last result'. A 'Follow the <Route> route' button calls writeSelectedRoute. 'Go to dashboard' is always shown. The /api/me/assessments POST happens only when the target is 'server', and the tracking-gated assessment center link is removed.
Mostly mock content (random project scores, mock skills and certifications). It returns notFound() while 'tracking' is off instead of showing a 'disabled' page, and nothing links to it.
Its body is '[Placeholder: …]' text. It returns notFound() unless 'personalization' is on (a draft preview) and is not linked anywhere.

featureDecisions.feature: History page /history (History of SystemVerilog and UVM)
featureDecisions.details: Its prose is placeholder text. The requireSession, Prisma and force-dynamic code goes, and it returns notFound() unless 'personalization' is on. Learner activity history is on the dashboard instead (recent activity from the local log).
They need account events and preferences. The page returns notFound() when accountUI is off instead of an empty placeholder, and the navbar feed is already hidden behind accountUI.

The notFound gate and requireSession go, and the page becomes a static shell. It holds Appearance (ThemeSwitcher, next-themes) and 'Your learning data' (storage status, usage, export, import, reset). The notification, digest, quiet-hours and telemetry panel moves to AccountPreferencesPanel, which renders only when the target is 'server' and loads with GET /api/me/preferences.

The personalization gate and mock entries go. Entries come from local Teach-it-back saves and free notes, and the page supports list, search, edit with autosave, delete with an inline confirm, and 'Download as Markdown'. The AI feedback button appears only when SITE_FEATURES.aiTutor is on. The dead createNotebookEntry action is deleted.

Today it POSTs to the auth-guarded AI route and fails silently. Now 'Save to notebook' upserts a local teach-back entry for the lesson, and a static four-question self-check guides the explanation. AI feedback appears only when SITE_FEATURES.aiTutor is on. The pinned heading id teach-it-back stays.

featureDecisions.feature: Floating AI assistant (AIAssistantWidget on every learning page)
featureDecisions.details: It needs GEMINI_API_KEY and a per-user rate limit in Prisma. The widget renders only when SITE_FEATURES.aiTutor is on (aiTutor flag plus accounts), and /api/ai/* stay guarded.
They need data from several users. They stay 404 behind the community flag, with no change.

featureDecisions.feature: Account menu, sign-in UI and SessionProvider
featureDecisions.details: The account menu and notification bell are already hidden behind accountUI. In addition, SessionProvider is not mounted and useAuth returns a constant anonymous value when accounts are off. /api/auth/* answers 404, so the placeholder 'Sign in with Placeholder' page is gone.

featureDecisions.feature: Keyboard shortcut Alt+3 (dashboard) and its help row
featureDecisions.details: ShortcutFlags becomes {dashboard, community}. The dashboard shortcut is always available, and Alt+C stays tied to the community flag.
There is no UI for them. They stay as account-era endpoints that fail closed. The dashboard computes streak and activity from local data with pure helpers in src/lib/learner-stats.ts.
Already stored in the browser. The keys join export, import and reset, and the dashboard reads them.
Available lab pages are added, since they are now public static pages. The learner pages stay out of the sitemap and stay disallowed in robots.txt.

workPackages.title: Foundation: learner store, persistence switch, auth seam, shared learner UI, e2e mode
tasks: storage.ts: safeStorage (get, set, remove, keys(prefix)). The probe catches SecurityError and TypeError and falls back to an in-memory Map with status 'unavailable'. On QuotaExceededError (match the names QuotaExceededError and NS_ERROR_DOM_QUOTA_REACHED and the codes 22 and 1014) it keeps the value in a memory overlay with status 'full'. Export getStorageStatus, subscribeStorageStatus and estimateBytes(prefixes). It is SSR-safe: with no window it uses memory and stays silent.

record.ts: defineRecord and defineKeyedRecord as specified in the architecture. Envelope {v, data}; legacyRaw for bare legacy keys. Corrupt data reads as empty and is not overwritten until an explicit write. Older versions migrate and are written back. A newer version reads as empty and writes return 'blocked-newer-version'. Snapshot cache per raw string. Notify subscribers through an in-module event bus plus the window 'storage' event (key null means every record).
react.ts: useRecord, useKeyedRecord, useKeyedRecordList and useStorageStatus via useSyncExternalStore. getServerSnapshot returns the record's empty value, null, [] or 'available'.

keys.ts and time.ts: every key and prefix from the architecture, including the legacy strings ('curriculumProgress', ROUTE_STORAGE_KEY imported from src/lib/learning-route-state.ts, 'sv-uvm-guide:exercise:', 'sv-uvm-guide:exercise-analytics:'). Add localDayKey, endOfLocalDay and addDays.

repositories/*: the typed records, hand-written validators and small pure helpers named in the architecture (labRecordId, listLabRecords, isCardDue, countDueCards, upsertTeachBack, removeEntry, addPlacementAttempt, recordQuizResult, recordLessonVisit, recordActivity with 400-day pruning). Add curriculumProgressRecord (legacyRaw) exporting the type CurriculumProgressData, and the read-only legacy readers. No zod: these modules ship to the client.

backup.ts: exportLearnerData, importLearnerData(bundle, 'replace'|'merge') with per-entry validation and a count report, resetLearnerData (known keys only; leaves theme and the outline-collapsed key alone), estimateLearnerDataBytes.

persistence: accounts.ts exports ACCOUNTS_ENABLED. target.ts exports usePersistenceTarget, branching on the constant. persistence-gate.ts exports isServerPersistenceConfigured(env) and resolveServerPersistence() with a lazy import of '@/lib/auth'.
featureFlags.ts: add aiTutor and simulation (default false; NEXT_PUBLIC_FEATURE_FLAG_AI_TUTOR, NEXT_PUBLIC_FEATURE_FLAG_SIMULATION). site-features.ts: SITE_FEATURES as specified.

AuthContext.tsx: export useAuth = ACCOUNTS_ENABLED ? useSessionAuth : useAnonymousAuth, where useAnonymousAuth returns a stable module-level constant. AuthProvider is unchanged. ClientProviders.tsx: wrap in SessionProvider only when ACCOUNTS_ENABLED.

api/auth/[...nextauth]/route.ts: one handler for GET and POST. When !isServerPersistenceConfigured(), return NextResponse.json({error:'ACCOUNTS_DISABLED'}, {status:404}). Otherwise import next-auth and authOptions dynamically and delegate.
download.ts: downloadBlob and downloadText through an object URL and a temporary anchor, with revocation and SSR guards.

StorageStatusNote (aria-live polite; props savedLabel?, className): shows 'Saved in this browser', or a warning when status is 'unavailable' or 'full' or usage is over 3.5 MB. LearnerDataControls: Export (file sv-uvm-guide-learning-data-YYYY-MM-DD.json); Import (input type=file accept application/json, then a preview of counts, then Replace or Merge buttons, then a result status); Reset (two-step inline confirm, button 'Delete all learning data in this browser'). Every button is labelled, statuses use role=status, and nothing uses window.confirm. LearnerSectionNav({current}): nav aria-label 'Your learning' linking /dashboard, /dashboard/review, /dashboard/notebook and /settings, with aria-current='page'.

playwright.config.ts and scripts/run-e2e-tests.cjs: the default is anonymous (no flag variables, AUTH_TEST_MODE=false, DATABASE_URL empty, SESSION_SECRET defaulting to a dummy 32-character value). E2E_ACCOUNTS=true restores today's environment (all flags forced on plus test auth). tests/fixtures/auth.ts: export ACCOUNTS_E2E and requireAccountsMode(test), which calls test.skip with a reason when not in accounts mode, and keep authenticateTestLearner.
tests: storage.test.ts: available round trip; getItem throws SecurityError, giving memory fallback and status 'unavailable'; setItem throws QuotaExceededError, giving status 'full' while the value is still readable this session; subscribers notified

tasks: scheduler.ts (pure): scheduleReview(state|undefined, quality 0..5 integer, now) returns SrsCardState. risks: Worker serving of lab pages: this relies on OpenNext cache interception serving the prerendered lab HTML and RSC exactly as it does lessons. The lesson loader already reads content with fs at build and is served this way. If any lab request falls through to a server render on workerd, the fs reads fail. Verify with npm run cf:preview, after checking df, since a build needs about 1.5 GB. The fallback is to emit the lab file contents into a generated module.
Solutions become publicly reachable in the lab page payload. They are already in the public repo and the reveal is a learning nudge, not access control. The owner should sign off.

Learner data is per browser and per device and is lost when site data is cleared. In private mode it lasts only in memory for the session. Mitigations: StorageStatusNote warnings, export, import and reset in Settings, and lab 'Download files'.

localStorage holds about 5 MB per origin, shared by every feature: labs at most about 1 MB, flashcards about 200 KB, the notebook up to 500 entries of 8000 characters. A quota error switches to memory-only with a visible warning. If notebook use grows, move the notebook to IndexedDB behind the same record API.

Graded evidence written in the browser can be forged. That is acceptable without accounts. Evidence carries origin:'browser', and the future /api/me/import must re-grade with the versioned graders before writing LabAttempt.

Hydration and overwrite hazards: reading storage during render causes mismatches, and autosaving before the restore finishes would overwrite saved work with the starter code. The store's server snapshot and the loaded gate in useLabWorkspace prevent both. Reviewers should check every new client island.
Lab version bumps orphan saved work under the old key. It is kept and offered as a download, never silently migrated, because step ids and files may have changed.

Pinned tests: about 15 vitest and e2e assertions encode today's 404, sign-in or placeholder behaviour (LabLink, PracticeHub, LessonMdxPipeline, learning-paths, navigation-entry-points, feature-gating, feature-flags e2e, dashboard-page, PlacementQuiz, placement-links, shortcuts, KeyboardShortcuts, srs.spec, AIAssistantWidget, settings-page-client). Each must change in the same commit as its copy or behaviour; the package lists name their owners.

Switching Playwright's default to anonymous mode changes which specs run. Specs that silently relied on FEATURE_FLAGS_FORCE_ON need requireAccountsMode or a rewrite. The e2e suite is still blocked locally by missing system dependencies (OPS-1), so run targeted specs where possible.

NEXTAUTH_SECRET is still needed at build and at runtime, because the /api/me/*, /api/ai/*, /api/labs/run, /api/simulate and /api/reviews routes import src/lib/auth.ts at module load. Only the nextauth route becomes lazy.

With SessionProvider not mounted, any future component that calls next-auth's useSession directly will throw in dev while accounts are off. useAuth and usePersistenceTarget must stay the only identity entry points; document this in AuthContext.

Flipping the legacy flags (tracking, personalization, community) still exposes mock or placeholder pages (assessment center, projects, history, community). Those flags now mean draft or preview only and must stay off in production.
Streaks and due dates use the learner's local clock. Changing time zones or the device clock can shift a day. This is accepted and documented in learner-stats and time.ts.

Several agents edit in parallel. Packages own disjoint files, but generated outputs (search index, .next) and the shared working tree can still collide. Follow the integration-hygiene practice: commit explicit paths, and run generators and builds in a clean worktree.
